title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that lambda equals n times V_Q.

title: Statistical Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the transition from Fermi-Dirac and Bose-Einstein statistics to Maxwell-Boltzmann statistics under the condition lambda << 1.

title: Density of States
description: Important Criteria: The student must include the correct expression for the density of states for an ideal gas.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the integral for the density of states correctly, including the exponential factors.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common mistakes such as sign errors or incorrect factors in the exponential terms.

title: Quantum Volume Definition
description: Optional Criteria: The student should define the quantum volume V_Q correctly in their response.
